title: Define VPC and Network Topology (CDK)
description: Create a VPC with public/private subnets across 2 AZs, NAT Gateways, and Security Groups restricting access to internal resources.
acceptance_criteria: VPC created with CIDR 10.0.0.0/16; Public/Private subnets defined; NAT Gateways configured

title: Provision Aurora Serverless v2 & Secrets
description: Define Aurora PostgreSQL cluster with Secret Manager integration for credential rotation and IAM authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Aurora Cluster deployed in private subnets; Secrets Manager rotation configured

title: Provision ElastiCache Redis
description: Create Redis cluster for caching Google Books and Contentful API responses.
acceptance_criteria: Redis cluster deployed in private subnets; Auth token stored in Secrets Manager

title: Backend GitHub Actions Workflow
description: Create workflow to build .NET 8 solution, run unit/integration tests, build Docker image, push to ECR, and trigger CDK deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow triggers on push; Tests passing blocks deployment; Docker image tagged
business_value: Accelerates delivery and ensures consistent deployment

title: Implement Isar Schema & Repository
description: Define Isar entities for User, Book, Session. Implement BaseRepository with CRUD and fields for syncStatus.
acceptance_criteria: Entities generated; CRUD operations persist locally; Indexing optimized

title: Define & Implement Soft Delete (Tombstone) Pattern
description: Modify EF Core entities to implement ISoftDelete. Intercept SaveChanges to set IsDeleted = true.
acceptance_criteria: Deleting entity sets flag; Global query filter excludes deleted items; Sync Pull endpoint includes them
business_value: Required for correct sync of deletions

title: Implement Sync Queue & Network Listener
description: Create a service observing connectivity using connectivity_plus. When online, trigger SyncEngine.
acceptance_criteria: Detect network changes reliably; Queue persists across app restarts

title: Implement Sync 'Push' Endpoint (.NET)
description: Create POST /api/sync/push accepting batched entities. Implement conflict resolution using ClientTimestamp.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts JSON batch; Validates user ownership; Updates DB if ClientTimestamp > ServerTimestamp
business_value: Allows saving offline data to cloud

title: Implement Sync 'Pull' Endpoint (.NET)
description: Create GET /api/sync/pull accepting lastSyncTimestamp. Returns entities modified after timestamp.
acceptance_criteria: Query filters by UpdatedAt; Includes deleted items; Paged response
business_value: Keeps device up to date with cross-device changes

title: Implement 'Push' Sync Logic (Client to Server)
description: Develop logic to iterate dirty records, batch send to Backend API, update local syncStatus on success.
acceptance_criteria: Batch upload of reading sessions; Error handling for 5xx responses; Local records marked clean

title: Implement 'Pull' Sync Logic (Server to Client)
description: Logic to request delta updates from backend based on lastSyncTimestamp. Merge strategies for incoming data.
acceptance_criteria: Fetch only changed records; Update local Isar records; Handle deletions

title: Implement Flutter IAP Integration
description: Use in_app_purchase to fetch products, initiate purchase, and send receipt to backend.
acceptance_criteria: Products fetched; Purchase flow completes; Receipt sent to backend

title: Implement Apple App Store Webhooks Handler
description: Backend endpoint to receive and validate Apple Webhooks (JWS). Handle SUBSCRIBED, DID_RENEW, EXPIRED.
acceptance_criteria: Validates JWS signature; Idempotent processing; Updates User Role

title: Implement Google Play RTDN Handler
description: Backend worker to process Pub/Sub messages from Google Play. Decode payload, validate token.
acceptance_criteria: Connects to Google Pub/Sub; Validates purchase token; Updates User Role

title: Implement Backend Receipt Validation
description: Create POST /api/subscription/validate for client instant unlock.
acceptance_criteria: Calls Apple/Google verify API; Updates DB immediately

title: Implement Ad Consent Flow (UMP/ATT)
description: Integrate Google UMP SDK for GDPR/CCPA consent and Apple AppTrackingTransparency.
acceptance_criteria: CMP dialog shows on first launch; ATT prompt on iOS 14+; AdMob initializes only after consent

title: Implement Ad Banner Widget & Logic
description: Create reusable AdBanner widget. Logic to check user tier via Riverpod.
acceptance_criteria: Ad loads for Free user; No ad for Premium user; Layout handles failure

title: Implement Interstitial Ad Logic
description: Logic to count 'Log Session' actions. On every 3rd action, show Interstitial Ad.
acceptance_criteria: Counter persists locally; Ad loads in background; Shows on 3rd trigger

title: Implement OpenSearch Upsert Logic
description: Connect to OpenSearch Serverless. Create index with k-NN settings.
acceptance_criteria: Index mapping correct; Upsert successful; IAM Auth works

title: Implement Embedding Generation Service
description: Service to format user reading history, call OpenAI Embeddings API, and return vectors.
acceptance_criteria: Text truncated to token limits; Retries on 429; Returns float array

title: Implement User Context Background Job
description: Scheduled job to identify users with new activity, fetch history, call EmbeddingService, and update VectorStore.
acceptance_criteria: Batches users; Handles failures gracefully; Updates LastEmbedded timestamp

title: Implement RAG Recommendation Endpoint
description: Create POST /api/recommendations. Vector Search -> Prompt Construction -> GPT-4 Call -> Parse JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Validates Premium; Constructs context; Returns structured Book JSON

title: Implement Mobile Recommendation UI
description: UI to display list of recommended books with 'Add to Library' actions. Handle loading states.
acceptance_criteria: Loading shimmer; Display books; Error handling

title: Implement Async Job Polling (Client)
description: Implement polling mechanism on client to check job status if the endpoint is async.
acceptance_criteria: Polls every 2s; Timeout after 30s; Updates UI on completion
